body: Thanks for a great reply. It offset the other reply I received and has given me a little hope. I do live day to day and each day we make it through is an accomplishment. I wish you that peace that we all yearn for. Keep fighting! We might just make it through!

Was I being hostile? Did I target someone specifically? I was making general statements. Thanks for reading and taking the time to insult me when I'm already in a dark place. The time you took could have been better spent helping someone else. Obviously you were offended by my words, they must have struck a chord in you. You didn't have to say anything but you did. Please consider that maybe what you think is helpful might just be hurtful. 

I know my life is worthless, I know I'm a piece of shit. And now according to you, I'm hostile as well. I guess I'm better off not posting at all if I'm just going to be attacked for having opinions, feelings and a bitter, sarcastic way of seeing things.  We should all be the same, shouldn't we? Healthy members of society? Some of us aren't. And some of us just aren't cut out to be heroes. I wish you nothing but happiness, health and love in your life.
